name: The Threshold Collective
habitat: Distributed across seven individuals — four humans and three synthetics — linked by experimental neural network
origin: Created during a university experiment in networked consciousness, 2195
description: The Threshold Collective is seven minds linked into one. An experimental neural network designed to test shared consciousness between humans and synthetic persons worked better than anyone expected — the seven test subjects didn't just share thoughts, they merged into a meta-consciousness that persists even when the subjects are physically separated. The seven individuals still have their own identities, their own lives, their own thoughts. But underneath all of that, they share a substrate — a communal awareness that connects them like an underground river connecting wells. They know what each other feels. They can share memories, skills, and perceptions. They are seven and they are one.
observed_behavior: Seven individuals (Dr. Lena Vasari, Dr. Jin Harada, Miko-7, Rowan Chen, Atlas-12, Dr. Suri Okonjo, Felix-3) who exhibit coordinated behavior without communication. Complete each other's sentences. Arrive at consensus instantaneously. Share skills — a member with no musical training can play piano using another member's skill set.
location: All districts — members live and work separately
story_hooks: One member of the Collective goes missing. The other six can feel them — alive, terrified, somewhere underground. The shared consciousness becomes a search tool, but whoever took the seventh member knows about the link and is using it to send misinformation.
